text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Today's a day off, huh.
Guess I'll go do some shopping or something~.

text_block_list.name: Show Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Today's fortune ranking... in 3rd place is Aries!
Looks like something even better than usual might happen today!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm?
Something even better than usual, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cashier Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Lucky you, missy!
You just hit the jackpot on the receipt raffle~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, grand prize winner!?
...N-No way, first prize—

text_block_list.name: Cashier Lady
text_block_list.text:
"3rd Prize"!!
It's a dark horse prize that no one has won yet~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...No, no, what if the prize is actually super, crazily lavish...?!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, the 3rd place prize is... 33 scrubbing brushes!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Aha... Ahaha.
Guess you really shouldn't... get your hopes up."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature's shoulders slumped in utter defeat,
clutching her head over the grim fate of the scrub brush...
